t: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp

d: Army mule and horse remounts are stolen from a Tombstone stable. The owner was severely injured and didn't see the robbers but Roscoe did and was kicked by a stolen mule.

d: After Wells Fargo is robbed and an agent killed, Thacker pressures Earp to capture the killers.
